CustomField.description: This field gives you the list of Primary donors and the Pledge amount of that specific Pledge
CustomField.formula: Pledge_Name__c & " - $" & IF( Report_Amount_USD__c >= 1000000000, TEXT(FLOOR(Report_Amount_USD__c / 1000000000)) & ",", "" ) & IF( Report_Amount_USD__c >= 1000000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Report_Amount_USD__c / 1000000)), 3) & ",", "" ) & IF( Report_Amount_USD__c >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Report_Amount_USD__c / 1000)), 3) & ",", "" ) & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Report_Amount_USD__c)), 3) & IF( Anonymous__c = TRUE, " - Anonymous", "" ) & IF( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pledged")), " (" & TEXT(Status__c) & ")", "" )
CustomField.label: Ask/Pledge Name
